newsitem.title: UK: Manchester Utd up after UBS recommendation.
newsitem.headline: Manchester Utd up after UBS recommendation.

text.p: Shares in Manchester United Plc hit a record close on Monday after the premier league soccer club recorded a potentially significant victory and as UBS highlighted the stock in a review of the FTSE 250, traders said.
The stock closed 15p higher at 573, beating the previous highest close of 568p set November 22.

UBS said Manchester United had "achieved a material shift in the quality of its earnings" and that it had "arguably the strongest brand in the game and (with) strong earnings growth expected on the basis of capacity increases and a new sponsorship deal, growth prospects look outstanding."

Saturday's 3-1 win over Leicester came ahead of United's European chamipions' league game on Wednesday in Vienna, which is crucial for the UK club to progress to the next round of the lucrative competition.
